# User-supplied analytic notation converter

The `visual_hive` Python package is copied verbatim from George's
`~/Desktop/Visual-Hive-Translator-Mac.zip`, specifically
`Visual Hive Translator.app/Contents/Resources/visual_hive/`.
Imported September 11, 2026 at George's explicit request. Its source calls the
format Visual Hive; the FoulBrood UI names it **Analytic notation**, as requested.

Only conversion is used. FoulBrood's tested Rust engine remains authoritative for
legal moves, history, repetition and outcomes. Conversion failures must remain
visible and never be replaced with invented analytic moves. The original ZIP
and desktop app are unchanged. The app launcher and file-writing program from
the ZIP are not run or incorporated.
